- Fixed: installing stopped with "cannot mount /product" on many devices with
  dynamic partitions. The read-only flag on the partition was never cleared,
  because the code looked for it under the partition's name instead of the
  device-mapper name it is actually filed under, so every write failed. If
  0.3.0 refused to mount a partition for you, this is it
- The installer now keeps looking for a partition across every block device
  directory, rather than giving up on the first one it checks
- The installer works out the A/B slot from what recovery has mounted when the
  device does not report one
- When a partition still cannot be mounted, the error says why: missing,
  read-only format, or mounted but refusing writes
